info.description:
AdaptiveRoute routes each query to one of five specialised LLM agents
(code, math, sql, writer, knowledge) using one of four strategies:
**round_robin**, **embedding**, **llm** and **adaptive**.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` (or `X-API-Key`). Errors use
`application/problem+json`. POST /v1/queries accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header.
info.title: AdaptiveRoute API

post.description:
Routes the query with the chosen strategy, stores the decision and, unless
`execute=false`, runs the selected agent. With `mode=async` the agent runs on the
Celery worker and the response is `202` with `status=queued`.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: a repeated request with the
same key returns the stored response instead of executing again.
